about: The most widely used Python code formatter.

prs.title: Formatting a selection keeps stacked decorators valid
prs.broken: Formatting only some lines of a file indented with two spaces or tabs broke stacked decorators elsewhere, and Black stopped with an invalid code error.
prs.changed: Each decorator outside the selection is now kept and re-indented on its own.
prs.matters: Format-selection in editors works on these files.
